---
title: "omicsCore report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    df_print: kable
params:
  project: NULL
  project_name: "omics_project"

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
# Anything a person typed -- a project name, a layer tag, a group
# label, a feature id -- is inserted into markdown here, and markdown
# passes raw HTML through. Escaped once, at the seam, so a name that
# carries "<script>" reads as that text rather than running as it.
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
esc_df <- function(df) {
  for (nm in names(df)) {
    if (is.character(df[[nm]]) || is.factor(df[[nm]])) {
      df[[nm]] <- esc(as.character(df[[nm]]))
    }
  }
  names(df) <- esc(names(df))
  df
}

# A parameter as a reader can check it. "12 entries" told them a number
# and nothing about the analysis; what they need is which contrast, which
# covariates, which thresholds -- the things that would have to match for
# somebody else to get the same numbers.
fmt_value <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) return("_not set_")
  if (is.data.frame(x)) return(sprintf("_%d x %d table_", nrow(x), ncol(x)))
  if (is.list(x)) return(paste(names(x) %||% seq_along(x), collapse = ", "))
  if (length(x) > 8L) {
    return(paste0(paste(esc(utils::head(x, 8L)), collapse = ", "),
                  sprintf(" _(and %d more)_", length(x) - 8L)))
  }
  paste(esc(format(x)), collapse = ", ")
}

params_table <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0L) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    Parameter = esc(names(p)),
    Value = vapply(p, fmt_value, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Full tables, not the first ten rows. A report whose numbers cannot be
# checked against anything is a summary of an analysis, not a record of
# one -- and a reader who has to go back to the application to see row 11
# has been given a screenshot with extra steps.
#
# Bounded all the same, because a differential result is tens of thousands
# of rows and a self-contained HTML file holding all of them helps nobody.
# The bound is stated wherever it bites.
MAX_ROWS <- 2000L

full_table <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  shown <- utils::head(df, MAX_ROWS)
  print(knitr::kable(esc_df(shown), caption = caption))
  if (n > MAX_ROWS) {
    cat(sprintf("\n_Showing the first %s of %s rows. The complete table is in the exported bundle._\n\n",
                format(MAX_ROWS, big.mark = ","), format(n, big.mark = ",")))
  }
}

project <- params$project
project_name <- params$project_name
bundles <- if (is.null(project$bundles)) list() else project$bundles

# Plots come from the same functions the application draws with, so the
# report shows what the analyst saw rather than a second rendering that
# could disagree with it.
try_plot <- function(expr, what) {
  p <- tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(p, "error")) {
    cat(sprintf("\n_%s could not be drawn: %s_\n\n", esc(what),
                esc(conditionMessage(p))))
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }
  print(p)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

# `r esc(project_name)`

## Project overview

- **Project:** `r esc(project$name %||% project_name)`
- **Experiments:** `r paste(esc(omicsCore::experiment_tags(project)), collapse = ", ")`
- **Sample link:** `r if (!is.null(project$sample_link)) paste0(nrow(project$sample_link), " mapping rows") else "none"`

```{r overview-table}
exp_tags <- omicsCore::experiment_tags(project)
if (length(exp_tags) > 0L) {
  rows <- lapply(exp_tags, function(t) {
    eff <- omicsCore::effective_input(project, t)
    x <- eff$input
    data.frame(
      tag = t,
      omics_type = x$omics_type %||% NA_character_,
      assay_type = x$assay_type %||% NA_character_,
      # As the analyses saw it. Reporting the imported shape while the
      # analyses ran on a QC-cleaned layer describes a dataset nothing
      # was computed on.
      data_used = if (identical(eff$source, "qc_cleaned")) "QC-cleaned" else "raw import",
      n_features = nrow(x$expr_mat),
      n_samples = ncol(x$expr_mat),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(esc_df(do.call(rbind, rows)))
}
```

## How each layer was prepared

```{r provenance, results = "asis"}
# What actually happened to the data, step by step. Without it a reader
# cannot tell a log2-normalized layer from one that arrived that way, and
# those are different analyses.
any_steps <- FALSE
for (t in exp_tags) {
  steps <- omicsCore::provenance_steps(omicsCore::effective_input(project, t)$input)
  cat("\n### ", esc(t), "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (length(steps) == 0L) {
    cat("_This layer was imported before its processing was recorded, so what happened between the file and these values is not known._\n\n")
    next
  }
  any_steps <- TRUE
  for (i in seq_along(steps)) {
    st <- steps[[i]]
    cat(sprintf("%d. **%s**\n\n", i, esc(st$op)))
    tbl <- params_table(st$args)
    if (!is.null(tbl)) print(knitr::kable(tbl))
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

## Analyses

```{r bundles-section, results = "asis"}
if (length(bundles) == 0L) {
  cat("_No analyses are attached to this project._\n")
} else {
  for (nm in names(bundles)) {
    b <- bundles[[nm]]
    cat("\n### ", esc(nm), " (", esc(b$analysis_name), ")\n\n", sep = "")

    # The model, stated. This is the part a reader needs in order to
    # judge the numbers below, and it was the part reduced to a count.
    tbl <- params_table(b$params)
    if (!is.null(tbl)) {
      cat("\n**Settings**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(tbl))
      cat("\n")
    }

    pb <- b$provenance_binding
    if (!is.null(pb)) {
      cat("\n**Computed from**\n\n")
      cat(sprintf("- Layers: %s\n",
                  paste(esc(names(pb$inputs)), collapse = ", ")))
      if (length(pb$upstream_ids) > 0L) {
        cat(sprintf("- Derived from: %s\n",
                    paste(esc(pb$upstream_ids), collapse = ", ")))
      }
      cat("\n")
    }

    # An integration whose two layers were modelled differently says so
    # here, not only in the notification the analyst saw once.
    if (length(b$params$unadjusted_secondary) > 0L) {
      cat(sprintf("\n> **The two layers were modelled differently.** The first adjusts for %s; the second has no such column and was run unadjusted.\n\n",
                  paste(esc(b$params$unadjusted_secondary), collapse = ", ")))
    }

    for (rk in names(b$results)) {
      obj <- b$results[[rk]]
      if (is.data.frame(obj) && nrow(obj) > 0L) {
        cat("\n**", esc(rk), "**\n\n", sep = "")
        full_table(obj)
      }
    }

    cat("\n**Figures**\n\n")
    if (identical(b$analysis_name, "run_diff")) {
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_volcano(b), "Volcano plot")
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_ma(b), "MA plot")
    } else if (identical(b$analysis_name, "run_enrichment")) {
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_enrichment(b), "Enrichment plot")
    } else if (identical(b$analysis_name, "run_integration")) {
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_integration(b, view = "effect_pair"), "Effect pair")
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_integration(b, view = "quadrant"), "Quadrant counts")
    } else if (identical(b$analysis_name, "run_qc")) {
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_qc(b, view = "missingness"), "Missingness")
      try_plot(omicsCore::plot_qc(b, view = "pca"), "PCA")
    } else {
      cat("_No standard figure for this analysis type._\n\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

## Superseded results

```{r retired, results = "asis"}
# Kept visible rather than deleted, and clearly marked. A result the data
# has moved past is part of what happened; presenting it as current is
# what the retirement machinery exists to prevent.
retired <- project$retired %||% list()
if (length(retired) == 0L) {
  cat("_None._\n")
} else {
  rows <- lapply(retired, function(h) data.frame(
    analysis = h$analysis_name %||% NA_character_,
    view = h$view_slot %||% NA_character_,
    retired_at = h$retired_at %||% NA_character_,
    reason = h$retired_because %||% NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  knitr::kable(esc_df(do.call(rbind, rows)))
  cat("\n_These are no longer about this project's current data and were not used above._\n")
}
```

## Reproducing this

```{r versions, results = "asis"}
cat(sprintf("- omicsCore %s\n", as.character(utils::packageVersion("omicsCore"))))
cat(sprintf("- %s\n", R.version.string))
gs <- unique(unlist(lapply(bundles, function(b) b$params$geneset_sources)))
if (length(gs) > 0L) {
  cat(sprintf("- Gene sets: %s\n", paste(esc(gs), collapse = ", ")))
}
cat("\nUse `omicsCore::export_script()` on this project for a runnable script that reproduces the numbers above.\n")
```
